label: input u at step 3 (4th original token), boosted by earlier j/u/w/b
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit, active only in the original phase. 94% of activation mass is on input u, 91% at t=3 (4th original token); small leftovers at t=2/4 and on input w (also some o). Never fires in delimiter or copy phase. u at t=3 alone gets about 86% of mass but only 8% precision: whether it fires depends on the prefix. First token j (36% of mass, 8.7x lift) and earlier u/w/b/k/n/2 make it more likely and larger; top examples are j _ _ u. Requiring one of j/u/w/b earlier gives precision ~0.22 and mass recall ~0.81. The exact prefix dependence is not captured by any simple set, so precision stays low.
